resources.string: iPhone Duo style blur when you open or close your Fold.
No hinge sensor. Backup mode: the blur plays when the screen switches.
Samsung window blur is off on this phone. That is OK: screen capture mode is used instead.
Watch the hinge angle above. Start angle: the blur begins after the phone opens past this. End angle: the screen is fully sharp at this angle.

If the effect stops after some time: Settings > Apps > FoldBlur > Battery > Unrestricted. Also in Settings > Battery > Background usage limits, add FoldBlur to \"Never sleeping apps\".\n\nThe blur covers the screen only while the hinge moves. If you hold the phone half open, it fades away by itself.
Open or close your phone to see it
Screen capture is OFF. Tap \"Turn on real blur\" below.
Turn on real blur (allow screen capture)
Could not open the screen capture permission
Screen capture not allowed. Only a dark tint will show.

Android stops screen capture every time the phone locks. To keep it on: open Developer options and turn ON \"Turn off screen share protections\". Without this, open FoldBlur and tap \"Turn on real blur\" again after each lock.
Real blur is off. Tap to open FoldBlur and turn on screen capture.
Screen capture stopped (phone locked). Tap to open FoldBlur and turn on real blur again.
